records.title: Toward Objectification of Subjective Chronic Pain Based on Implicit Response in Biosignals

decisions.notes: The primary abstract does not establish the participant split, confidence intervals, calibration, external validation or whether feature selection was nested within resampling. The target is patient-versus-control status, not continuous pain severity or treatment response. Primary NLM abstract rechecked 2026-09-28: the reported endpoint is chronic-pain patient versus normal-control case status, not clinical functioning, pain-intensity regression or treatment response. Full Methods remain unavailable; participant-disjoint split, calibration and external validation cannot be determined.
